description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Ice/Dark/NE hybrid attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.2 En-Ice Stack or Lv.2 En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Ice/Dark Damage +20%, Physical/Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases 2 Ice/Dark abilities with Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns/3 turns/15 seconds to user/party/party with at least 0/4/4 Spellblade/T0 members & 0/0/3 Spellblade Abilities in party (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Ice/Dark, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Boreal Blade+: 1.65s CT, Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
